SWM Project · 2026 · U Lab, UIUC · Research Co-Lead

Lead post-training and evaluation of Qwen3-4B with GRPO for prediction-market probability forecasting.

Sign Language Translation with 3D Motion Representations · 2026 · DGene Inc.

Investigated SMPL-X representations and 3D motion priors for end-to-end sign language translation, adapting baseline models to test the feasibility of 3D inputs.
Designed probing experiments showing that intermediate motion-capture representations retain confidence-related information lost in the final decoded poses.
Replaced Uni-Sign’s ST-GCN encoder with a motion-capture-pretrained model: with the same RGB videos and hyperparameters, it reached comparable CSL-News translation performance in fewer training steps.

Led model evaluation, including task-specific evaluation metrics.

title: ARC-AGI-2: Fit the Whale
text:
81.81, 5th on the public leaderboard (competition ongoing). Full details in the Kaggle Technical Writeup.



An end-to-end agent and inference stack that deploys DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Kaggle’s 4×L4 machines to solve ARC-AGI-2.




Agentic collapse after pruning 60% of routed experts: invisible to teacher-forced NLL, but multi-turn execution broke. Protecting structural-token and single-character experts restored it.
Getting accuracy back: layer-group swap-back experiments showed the recoverable loss sat in the final 5 layers; rank-16 expert LoRAs trained with offline forward-KL distillation on a 625-task synthetic set recovered full-model accuracy.
Harness and scheduling: a multi-turn Python harness and an 80-sequence SGLang serving scheduler, pairing 100k-token budgets with pseudo-@2 dual submissions under L4 memory-bandwidth limits.

title: ARC-AGI-2: Fit the Whale
text:
做了什么
在 Kaggle 的 4×L4 环境里，端到端搭建智能体与推理栈，部署 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 解 ARC-AGI-2。

title: ARC-AGI-2: Fit the Whale
text:
几个关键点

剪掉 60% 路由专家后的”智能体崩溃”：teacher-forced NLL 几乎看不出问题，但多轮执行会失效。保护结构 token 和单字符专家后恢复正常。
把精度找回来：分层组换回实验显示可恢复的损失集中在最后 5 层；在 625 题合成数据上，用离线前向 KL 蒸馏训练 rank-16 专家 LoRA，恢复到完整模型的准确率。
harness 与调度：多轮 Python harness，加上 80 序列的 SGLang 调度器；在 L4 显存带宽限制下，配合 100k token 预算与伪 @2 双提交。
